title: Despite two losses, Lakers still No. 1
heading: 2003-04 Power Rankings: Week 7

rankings.summaryHtml: No one's hurt, so it must have been boredom. Or maybe Mavs (then Blazers) simply outplayed the consensus No. 1 squad. At both ends.
rankings.summaryText: No one's hurt, so it must have been boredom. Or maybe Mavs (then Blazers) simply outplayed the consensus No. 1 squad. At both ends.

rankings.summaryHtml: Clearly still Kings of playing hurt, surpassing 15-5 start without Webb in 2001-02. But the road beckons.
rankings.summaryText: Clearly still Kings of playing hurt, surpassing 15-5 start without Webb in 2001-02. But the road beckons.

rankings.summaryHtml: Just a so-so week, but Pacers remain the only team around that can say it hasn't lost more than one in a row.
rankings.summaryText: Just a so-so week, but Pacers remain the only team around that can say it hasn't lost more than one in a row.

rankings.summaryHtml: We'd like to claim we saw that win over the Lakers coming -- after a fall-from-ahead loss to Clips in same building -- but at least we were ahead of the curve on Josh Howard.
rankings.summaryText: We'd like to claim we saw that win over the Lakers coming -- after a fall-from-ahead loss to Clips in same building -- but at least we were ahead of the curve on Josh Howard.

rankings.summaryHtml: Didn't see this one coming, either, but Spurs suddenly have the longest active win streak in the whole league. Last place no more.
rankings.summaryText: Didn't see this one coming, either, but Spurs suddenly have the longest active win streak in the whole league. Last place no more.

rankings.summaryHtml: Groovin' again, but discovered they might need Mash after all ... after Baron goes through 9-for-68 stretch on 3-pointers.
rankings.summaryText: Groovin' again, but discovered they might need Mash after all ... after Baron goes through 9-for-68 stretch on 3-pointers.

rankings.summaryHtml: On top of all the injuries, Wolves have blown four leads after starting the fourth quarter ahead. It happened only three times all last season.
rankings.summaryText: On top of all the injuries, Wolves have blown four leads after starting the fourth quarter ahead. It happened only three times all last season.

rankings.summaryHtml: As long as they hang onto a top-eight spot in the West, Rockets can live with being No. 3 in Texas for another season, as their trouble beating Spurs suggests.
rankings.summaryText: As long as they hang onto a top-eight spot in the West, Rockets can live with being No. 3 in Texas for another season, as their trouble beating Spurs suggests.

rankings.summaryHtml: After all those sappy stories about Hubie and J-Will ... what if Grizz is actually better with Earl Watson and Mike Miller running the point? Not that Memphis minds the confusion, reveling in what must be its first-ever taste of the top 10.
rankings.summaryText: After all those sappy stories about Hubie and J-Will ... what if Grizz is actually better with Earl Watson and Mike Miller running the point? Not that Memphis minds the confusion, reveling in what must be its first-ever taste of the top 10.

rankings.summaryHtml: No, Larry's not going to leave. Way too early for that. But that's all we can say definitively, with Pistons gripped by a sudden teamwide bout of indecisiveness.
rankings.summaryText: No, Larry's not going to leave. Way too early for that. But that's all we can say definitively, with Pistons gripped by a sudden teamwide bout of indecisiveness.

rankings.summaryHtml: Took advantage of Iverson's absence to start a tough trip with a win at Philly. If Jazz is still over .500 after the five road games that follow, no one will be able to call them flukey.
rankings.summaryText: Took advantage of Iverson's absence to start a tough trip with a win at Philly. If Jazz is still over .500 after the five road games that follow, no one will be able to call them flukey.

rankings.summaryHtml: Staying in front of Grizz and Jazz, not Mavs and Spurs, is the realistic goal. Yet that'll be tough, too.
rankings.summaryText: Staying in front of Grizz and Jazz, not Mavs and Spurs, is the realistic goal. Yet that'll be tough, too.

rankings.summaryHtml: For once, we're going to ignore Hurricane 'Sheed because we're still struggling to believe that Coach Cheeks was kicked out of a game a week ago. Apparently it IS contagious.
rankings.summaryText: For once, we're going to ignore Hurricane 'Sheed because we're still struggling to believe that Coach Cheeks was kicked out of a game a week ago. Apparently it IS contagious.

rankings.summaryHtml: Celts looking for bigs to replace fallen Raef, but they've found their offense and, somehow, first place. Just in time for 'Toine's return.
rankings.summaryText: Celts looking for bigs to replace fallen Raef, but they've found their offense and, somehow, first place. Just in time for 'Toine's return.

rankings.summaryHtml: Raps drop two straight to halt the honeymoon before the schedule starts really getting hard. Next two are at Dallas and at San Antonio.
rankings.summaryText: Raps drop two straight to halt the honeymoon before the schedule starts really getting hard. Next two are at Dallas and at San Antonio.

rankings.summaryHtml: Happy holidays: In only three games at home between now and New Year's, visitors will be Lakers, Kings and surging Celtics.
rankings.summaryText: Happy holidays: In only three games at home between now and New Year's, visitors will be Lakers, Kings and surging Celtics.

rankings.summaryHtml: The four-game win streak obviously wasn't a cure-all. The consolation: Memphis is off the schedule until the NBA Finals.
rankings.summaryText: The four-game win streak obviously wasn't a cure-all. The consolation: Memphis is off the schedule until the NBA Finals.

rankings.summaryHtml: Tough to get excited about Big Dog's long-awaited return when AI misses two games in one week. Which never happens.
rankings.summaryText: Tough to get excited about Big Dog's long-awaited return when AI misses two games in one week. Which never happens.

rankings.summaryHtml: Payton's place is in L.A. now, yet it seems as though Sonics are still awash in tension. We're also not quite clear how glue guy Brent Barry became 'expendable,' as the committee keeps reading elsewhere.
rankings.summaryText: Payton's place is in L.A. now, yet it seems as though Sonics are still awash in tension. We're also not quite clear how glue guy Brent Barry became 'expendable,' as the committee keeps reading elsewhere.

rankings.summaryHtml: Only losses in month of December: Jazz and Kings on the road, Wolves at home by a basket. Clips are overachiveving.
rankings.summaryText: Only losses in month of December: Jazz and Kings on the road, Wolves at home by a basket. Clips are overachiveving.

rankings.summaryHtml: Bucks continue to contend for a top-five spot in the Overachiever Standings, too. Staying up there will be tough, though, if Kukoc and Skinner don't heal soon.
rankings.summaryText: Bucks continue to contend for a top-five spot in the Overachiever Standings, too. Staying up there will be tough, though, if Kukoc and Skinner don't heal soon.

rankings.summaryHtml: Standings say Heat is almost a .500 team vs. East opposition (5-6). Stats say Odom (16.5 ppg, 8.8 rpg) doing all he can.
rankings.summaryText: Standings say Heat is almost a .500 team vs. East opposition (5-6). Stats say Odom (16.5 ppg, 8.8 rpg) doing all he can.

rankings.summaryHtml: Now that they've changed coaches, and they're still struggling, Suns will have to blame the Curse of the No. 8 Seed. Phoenix and Orlando are apparently both victims.
rankings.summaryText: Now that they've changed coaches, and they're still struggling, Suns will have to blame the Curse of the No. 8 Seed. Phoenix and Orlando are apparently both victims.

rankings.summaryHtml: Welcome back, Dice: Knicks roll to an 0-5 trip for just the third time in 25 years. Back home, though, Knicks are 2-1 with Dice.
rankings.summaryText: Welcome back, Dice: Knicks roll to an 0-5 trip for just the third time in 25 years. Back home, though, Knicks are 2-1 with Dice.

rankings.summaryHtml: Have we seen the last of Scottie Pip? Skiles, at 2-4, has plenty of problems to solve before even tackling that one.
rankings.summaryText: Have we seen the last of Scottie Pip? Skiles, at 2-4, has plenty of problems to solve before even tackling that one.

rankings.summaryHtml: There's an interesting little race brewing. Let's see what happens first for Cavs: trading Ricky Davis or winning on the road.
rankings.summaryText: There's an interesting little race brewing. Let's see what happens first for Cavs: trading Ricky Davis or winning on the road.

rankings.summaryHtml: Johnny Davis was on the Cleveland team that started 2-19 in 1984-85 ... and still made the playoffs. No wonder he's always so upbeat.
rankings.summaryText: Johnny Davis was on the Cleveland team that started 2-19 in 1984-85 ... and still made the playoffs. No wonder he's always so upbeat.

rankings.summaryHtml: Stuck in the past? Committee might be guilty because -- big surprise -- we love the green unis. Much as we like so many other retro looks.
rankings.summaryText: Stuck in the past? Committee might be guilty because -- big surprise -- we love the green unis. Much as we like so many other retro looks.

rankings.summaryHtml: Yet again we can say Wiz would have preferred a guarantee from Arenas that A) he'd be healthy and B) he wouldn't get ejected from games when he's out injured.
